summary: Dependency-free SVG line or area chart: multiple series distinguished by color, dash pattern and marker shape, keyboard navigation and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Trends over time or across ordered categories (months, days, versions).
Comparing a few series (up to 6 remain distinguishable by color, dash pattern and marker).
Area variant to emphasize the volume of a single series.
whenNotToUse: Unordered categories or comparing quantities: use BarChart.
Parts of a whole: use DonutChart.
Compact trend inside text or a KPI: use Sparkline.
Thousands of points or interactive zoom/brush: you need a dedicated library.

props.name: series
props.description: Series; data[i] maps to categories[i]. null leaves a gap in the line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Lines only, or lines with a filled area below (the axis includes zero).

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: description
props.description: Visible description below the title (period, unit, source).

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in px; width follows the container.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of values and ticks (currency, percent, compact…) in the current locale.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend; with multiple series each entry is a button that shows/hides the series.

props.name: hiddenSeries / defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the hidden series (controlled / uncontrolled).

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called when the legend changes the visible series.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradients, rounded shapes and glows with the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area (and then to the legend and the table button).
Next category: shows the values and announces them.

accessibility: <figure> + <figcaption> structure; the chart area is a focusable role="group", named by the title and described by a hint on using the arrow keys.
Keyboard movement updates an aria-live="polite" region with the category and formatted values; hovering shows the same readout without announcements.
The SVG is decorative (aria-hidden): the full data is in the table with a caption, column and row headers, opened by the "Show data table" button (aria-expanded).
Series do not rely on color alone: dash pattern and marker shape change per series; the legend uses aria-pressed.
In forced-colors, lines use CanvasText and the selection uses Highlight.
responsive: Width is measured with ResizeObserver (only inside an effect; falls back to 560 px in SSR) and X-axis labels are thinned out when space runs short.
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints with gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default; in forced-colors it goes back to flat.
Series colors: tokens --dc-color-data-1…6 (roles generated by the theme), assigned cyclically.
commonMistakes: Passing data whose length differs from categories: missing values are treated as empty.
Using 0 instead of null for missing data, which distorts the trend.
Formatting numbers by hand instead of using formatOptions (ignores the locale).

examples.name: WithGaps
examples.title: Missing data
examples.description: null values break the line; isolated points remain visible as markers.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradients and glows using the theme colors.

limits: Straight segments only (no curve interpolation), a single linear Y axis and discrete categories on the X axis.
No zoom/brush or virtualization: designed for tens to hundreds of points.
Label width is estimated (no text measurement): very long labels may overlap or be clipped.
The SVG is still drawn left to right in RTL.
